verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's Computer feature has a per-chat tool approval mode. In 'auto' mode, nothing changes on disk and no command runs until the user approves it, and pending actions appear as tool cards with Allow/Deny buttons. That covers the approval-prompt and opt-in mode parts of the story. missing for 10: documented command allowlists, elevated modes that are opt-in per action rather than per chat, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, dangerous actions require my explicit approval — command allowlists, approval prompts, and elevated modes that are opt-in per action

citations.quote: Every chat has a tool approval mode, set from the + menu in the chat input
auto is the everyday setting: the AI can explore freely, but nothing changes on disk and no command runs until you say so.
